# tofukit_query (Data Source)

Query data source that executes LLM with instructions and returns structured output



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instruction` (Block List) Instructions to execute with the LLM (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--instruction))
- `model` (String) Model to use for the query. Defaults are provider-specific: 'haiku' for Claude, 'gpt-4' for OpenAI (when implemented), 'gemini-pro' for Gemini (when implemented)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source identifier
- `json` (String) The full JSON response from the LLM
- `text` (String) The extracted text message from the JSON response (value of 'message' field)

<a id="nestedblock--instruction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instruction`

Required:

- `prompt` (String) LLM-facing instruction describing what to query

Optional:

- `constraints` (List of String) Constraints that must be respected (what NOT to do)
